question: In the R4 position-phase element model, do label-free detected resonators form reproducibly, survive small perturbations, and depend causally on both coupling directions (geometry->mode and mode->geometry), with each direction's effect vanishing under its matched ablation?

hypotheses.H-M: geometry and activity influence one another
hypotheses.H-C_precursor: a stable structure exposes a reusable effective unit

model.neighbor_update: recomputed at the start of every RK4 step and held for its four stages

gm_ablations.no_geometry_to_mode: complete: w = 1 and phase coupling over the frozen neighbor topology of s0 (primary matched ablation)

statistics.unit: world (seed); its effect is the mean over its accepted resonators

verdict_rules.H-M: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE if identical-arm formation >= 0.8, both causality endpoints PASS and dose_response PASS; NOT_SUPPORTED if any of these FAILs; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.H-C_precursor: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE if H-M is supported and >= 90% of accepted identical-arm units meet every effective-state bound; NOT_SUPPORTED if fewer do; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.causality: PASS if at least 10 worlds have resonators, the intact paired-effect bootstrap CI lies above 0, and the complete matched-ablation CI includes 0 or its |mean| <= 0.2 x intact mean; FAIL if the intact CI includes 0 or lies below it; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
verdict_rules.primary_arm: identical; the heterogeneous arm is evaluated with the same rules and reported separately
verdict_rules.dose_response: per direction, intact dynamics: PASS if the mean effects are non-decreasing across the registered doses and the per-world highest-minus-lowest dose difference has a bootstrap CI above 0 (at least 10 worlds); FAIL if that CI lies below 0; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. The endpoint passes only if both directions pass, and fails if either fails

seeds.rule: final entropy drawn with secrets.randbits(63) at R002 registration (fresh; R001 final worlds are not reused); final worlds are never simulated before the recorded panel; smoke and tests use development worlds

endpoints.formation_identical: fraction of final worlds with >= 1 accepted resonator, Wilson 95% CI; expectation >= 0.8
endpoints.g_to_m_identical: G->M paired effect (intact, scale 1.5) and the complete matched ablation (w = 1 + frozen phase topology), bootstrap CIs; causality rule
endpoints.m_to_g_identical: M->G paired effect (intact, uniform phase replacement) and the complete matched ablation (J = 0), bootstrap CIs; causality rule
endpoints.not_a_clump_identical: detector accepts no resonator under J=K=0 (detector-validity gate)
endpoints.effective_state_identical: >= 90% of accepted units meet every effective-state bound (worst unit reported)
endpoints.ablation_formation: descriptive: formation counts and rejection reasons from the same initial worlds under J = 0, under w = 1, and the clump control
endpoints.numerical_checks: RK4 order with held neighbor sets, switching-limited full-model dt error, and permutation/translation/rotation/global-phase equivariance (implementation gate)
endpoints.dose_response_identical: G->M over scales 1.25/1.5/2.0 and M->G over phase kicks RMS 0.5/1.0/uniform, intact dynamics; dose-response rule
endpoints.g_to_m_channels_identical: descriptive: G->M effect with only w = 1, and with only the frozen phase topology, as a fraction of intact

gates: passing focused contracts for the exact dependency fingerprint
complete panel for every final world in both arms
source hashes stable during the run

supersedes.status: WITHDRAWN before independent review by the implementer's own recheck; its receipt is preserved unchanged and its recorded verdicts stand as history (H-M INCONCLUSIVE)
reasons: Its G->M matched ablation (w = 1) was incomplete: geometry still reached the phases through neighbor selection, while the M->G ablation (J = 0) was complete. The asymmetry was a registration error, and it produced the INCONCLUSIVE G->M verdict.
Causality verdicts were issued on as few as 2 worlds (heterogeneous arm, bootstrap over two values).
No falsifiable test remained once ablations are complete (their vanishing holds by construction); R002 adds a registered dose-response prediction.
The receipt stored only per-world means, not per-resonator effects.

registered_changes_from_proposal: Candidate groups are components of a graph joining pairs that are both close and phase-locked over the window (proposal: proximity only). Reason: in the heterogeneous arm, unlocked drifting elements merge with locked groups spatially, so proximity-only components never test the locked groups themselves.
Recovery kicks have fixed size (random direction, exact RMS) so rejection of a non-restoring clump is deterministic.
The J=K=0 clump is rejected by criterion 5 (phase-pattern recovery), not criteria 3-4: with identical omega and K=0, frozen phases trivially satisfy 3-4.

G->M adds an identical zero-mean phase probe kick (RMS 0.3) to both runs of the pair: exact synchrony is a fixed point for any geometry, so scaling alone cannot move a synchronized pattern; the statistic is the time-mean pattern deviation over 5 time units.
dt check split: RK4 order with held neighbor sets, plus a tolerance on the switching-limited full-model error (neighbor sets change at step boundaries, so the full model converges at first order).
Effective-state validity requires >= 90% of accepted units within bounds (worst reported); a single worst-unit maximum was fragile on development worlds where two groups drift apart.
Effective-state bounds and validity are judged on the identical arm (primary); thresholds settled on development worlds only.

Ablations are matched on state (each control/treated pair starts from the same intact formed state) and complete: G->M removes both geometric channels (w = 1 and the phase coupling's neighbor choice, frozen at s0); M->G sets J = 0. Single-channel G->M ablations are reported as a decomposition. R001 used w = 1 alone (incomplete) and a descriptive both-off; both superseded.
Formation from scratch under ablations is descriptive (J = 0, w = 1, and the J = K = 0 clump control).
Dose-response added as a registered falsifiable prediction (R002).
Verdicts require at least 10 worlds with resonators (R002).
